elements.name: Press Escape with a compact Options panel open

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with a solid face visible in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon is minimized to panel buttons
the user clicks the Options panel button
the Options commands appear in a temporary panel below the buttons
the Options panel button is highlighted
the user presses Escape
the temporary Options panel remains visible
the Options panel button remains highlighted
the user clicks a face of the part outside the panel
the temporary Options panel closes
the compact panel buttons remain visible

elements.name: Repeat the active compact panel button

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon is minimized to panel buttons
the user clicks the Options panel button
the temporary Options command panel appears below the button strip
the Options panel button is highlighted
the user clicks the Options panel button again
the temporary Options command panel remains visible
the Options panel button remains highlighted
the user opens the ribbon display-mode menu
the menu shows "Minimize to Panel Buttons" as selected
the temporary Options command panel remains visible
the user selects "Minimize to Tabs"
the temporary Options command panel closes
the ribbon displays tabs without a permanent panel-button strip

elements.name: Dismiss a compact panel using the selected tab

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon is minimized to panel buttons
the user clicks the Options panel button
the temporary Options command panel appears below the button strip
the user clicks the selected Tools tab
the temporary Options command panel closes
the Tools panel buttons remain visible

elements.name: Dismiss a compact panel using its lower title

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon is minimized to panel buttons
the user clicks the Options panel button
the temporary Options command panel appears below the button strip
the user clicks the Options title at the bottom of that panel
the temporary Options command panel closes
the Tools panel buttons remain visible
